name: Contextual On-Call Pager
headline: Reach the right person with the context already attached.
prompt: You are on call. Here is the issue reported in the voicemail.
description: Calls the current on-call person and supplies concise context captured from the original request. The workflow focuses on schedule lookup, retries, acknowledgement, and escalation.
readiness: Illustrative workflow; validate on-call schedules, contact permissions, retries, acknowledgements, and escalation policy.

business.application: Call the current on-call person and provide the issue context captured from the original voicemail.
business.roi: Reduce response time and remove manual pager coordination.
business.metrics: Time to acknowledge · Successful contacts · Escalation time

technical.systems: On-call schedule · Voicemail transcription · Outbound calling
technical.build: Schedule lookup, concise context generation, call retries, acknowledgment, and escalation to the next contact.

expected.description: Poster image for the video player (WebP).
